svg.aria-label: a4l layer stack as an engineering drawing with numbered callouts and a parts list
svg.title: a4l layer stack
svg.desc: Engineering-drawing view of the a4l stack. A dashed enclosure marks the single glibc process holding the unmodified APK, host ART, the vendored AOSP framework subset and a4l's C++23 native core. Below it, the host stack a4l does not own: compositor, PipeWire and VA-API, Mesa, DRM/KMS. Numbered callouts are resolved by the parts list.
